Meet The Polar Bears

Canada's Team. Built For The World.

The Toronto Polar Bears are the only Canadian franchise in the Pro Padel League — a ten-team North American circuit with global reach. Our roster is made up of top-50 ranked players from the International Padel Federation, competing across men's and women's divisions in a single, unified team format.

No gender division. No regional ceiling. A national market of 41 million Canadians and a sport doubling its global base every decade.

Padel becomes a fixture in Toronto, Montreal, and Vancouver — racket sports clubs adopt at scale.

Padel established as a top-tier participation sport across Canada — the trajectory Spain followed.

Built To Succeed

Five Pillars Of Long-Term Value.

i. Merchandise

Dressed To Impress

Nike has expressed interest in a merchandise partnership — a formal announcement would unlock licensed distribution across North America through Nike's retail and digital channels.

ii. Real Estate

A Toronto Home Base

A flagship multi-use destination is in development — padel club, café, wellness/spa, and curated retail under one roof. Existing shareholders receive ownership without additional capital investment.

iii. Broadcast

Padel Goes Prime Time

Broadcast revenue beginning in 2027 will form a notable income stream as the league expands its global TV distribution beyond 300 million households.

iv. Ecosystem

Toronto Sports City

Ongoing collaborations with the Raptors, Maple Leafs, Blue Jays and MLS ecosystem create cross-brand amplification, audience reach, and commercial partnership opportunities.

v. Sponsorship

Investment Momentum

The Toronto Polar Bears are approaching profitability on sponsorship alone — an exceptional position in the world of professional sports franchises.

Wear The North

Roar. Repeat.

The Polar Bears wordmark is becoming one of the most recognizable identities in Canadian sport. Caps, jerseys, lifestyle apparel — and a Nike partnership on the horizon that could place the brand in retail across the continent.
